definitions.gloss: sewing tools; sewing kit; sewing supplies
definitions.explanation: A collection of tools and materials used for sewing by hand or machine, including needles, thread, scissors, pins, and a thimble.

examples.japanese: {裁縫道具|さいほうどうぐ}を{出|だ}してボタンを{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I took out my sewing kit and sewed on a button.

examples.japanese: {小学校|しょうがっこう}の{家庭科|かていか}で{裁縫道具|さいほうどうぐ}を{買|か}わされた。
examples.english: We were made to buy sewing kits for home economics in elementary school.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}の{裁縫道具|さいほうどうぐ}には、{古|ふる}い{針山|はりやま}や{糸切|いときり}りばさみが{入|はい}っていた。
examples.english: In my grandmother's sewing kit, there was an old pincushion and thread-cutting scissors.

notes:
A compound of {裁縫|さいほう} (sewing, needlework) + {道具|どうぐ} (tools, implements). In Japan, children typically purchase a {裁縫道具|さいほうどうぐ}セット (sewing kit set) for {家庭科|かていか} (home economics) class in elementary school.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裁縫道具|さいほうどうぐ}セット: sewing kit set
- {裁縫道具|さいほうどうぐ}{箱|ばこ}: sewing box
- {裁縫道具|さいほうどうぐ}を{揃|そろ}える: to assemble sewing tools
- {裁縫道具|さいほうどうぐ}を{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く: to carry sewing tools

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {裁縫箱|さいほうばこ}: sewing box — the container that holds sewing tools
- ソーイングセット: sewing set — English loanword, often refers to compact travel kits
- {針箱|はりばこ}: needle box — traditional term for a sewing box
